blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Event cameras keep capturing structure where conventional cameras blur or saturate, which makes them attractive for 3D perception in fast or poorly lit scenes. Event datasets with dense 3D ground truth, however, are far smaller and less diverse than the image collections behind feed-forward 3D reconstruction models. We present Déjà-Events, an event-only model that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps from multiple views in a single forward pass. Rather than relying on scarce 3D labels, we distil it from Déjà View, a feed-forward RGB model that refines its tokens by repeatedly applying one shared transformer block. On paired RGB and event recordings, the event student learns to reproduce the frozen teacher's final tokens, which requires no depth or pose ground truth and trains only about 1% of its parameters. Because events are dense at edges and moving texture but nearly absent in textureless regions, we further introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which adapts the shared block's gates to events and adjusts them per patch by event density, so that accuracy holds as refinement steps are added. Trained only on simulated data, Déjà-Events achieves the lowest pointmap error among the event-based methods we evaluate, on EventScape and zero-shot on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets. On DSEC it halves the error of the strongest baseline (0.15 vs. 0.30 AbsRel) with about a tenth of its parameters. It also has the lowest depth error on EventScape and DSEC and the lowest trajectory error on EventScape.
blocks.zh: 事件相机在常规相机模糊或饱和的地方不断捕捉到结构,这使其在快速或亮度低的场景中吸引到3D感知. 然而,具有密集的3D地面真伪的事件数据集远比向上3D重建模型背后的图像集要小而多样. 我们向大家介绍Déjà-Events, 一种仅以事件为主的模型, 它从多个角度预测深度、相机姿势和指向。 我们不依赖稀缺的3D标签,而是从Déjà View中提取出,Déjà View是一种向导的RGB模型,它通过反复应用一个共享变压器块来完善它的代号. 在对齐的RGB和事件录音上,事件学生学会了复制被冷冻的老师最后的道具,这不需要深度或提出地上真言,训练的参数只有1%左右. 由于事件在边缘和移动的纹理上是密集的,但在无纹理的区域却几乎不存在,我们进一步引入了sparsity-aware可适应的地标,使共享块的地门适应于事件,并按事件密度调整每个地段,这样精确度就随着完善步骤的加入而保持. Déjà-Events只接受模拟数据训练,在我们评价的基于事件的方法中实现了最低点映射误差,在EventScape上实现了零拍取真实的MVSEC和DSEC数据集. 在DSEC上,它用大约十分之一的参数将最强基线(0.15对0.30 AbsRel)的误差减半. 它也拥有EventScape和DSEC上的最低深度误差和EventScape上的最低轨迹误差.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Robots that move fast or operate in poor lighting need the 3D geometry of their surroundings, and their own motion through it, with little delay, yet these are exactly the conditions in which frame cameras blur, saturate or under-expose [ 1 , 2 ] . Event cameras avoid much of this: each pixel asynchronously reports brightness changes as they happen, giving microsecond temporal resolution and a much higher dynamic range than conventional cameras [ 3 , 4 ] . These make events an attractive modality for 3D reconstruction in such scenes [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 快速移动或运行在灯光差的机器人需要其周围的3D几何,以及自己通过它运动,很少延迟,但这些正是帧相机模糊,饱和或曝光不足[1,2]的条件. 事件摄像头避免了其中的大部分:每个像素同步报告亮度随其发生而变化,给出微秒时间分辨率和比常规摄像头高得多的动态范围[3,4]. 这使得事件成为了这种场景中3D重建的有吸引力的模式[5].

blocks.en: Feed-forward reconstruction models predict camera poses, depth and 3D pointmaps from a set of images in a single forward pass [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . They are trained on large and diverse image collections with 3D annotations [ 6 , 8 ] , whereas event datasets with dense 3D ground truth are much smaller and less diverse [ 1 , 9 , 5 ] . We therefore distil geometry from an RGB model instead: a frozen RGB teacher sees RGB frames, and an event student learns to reproduce what the teacher computes from events paired with those frames alone, transferring the teacher’s priors to events [ 1 , 5 ] . Because the student inherits those priors but not the sensor, it can keep predicting structure where the teacher’s frames saturate (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh: Feed-forward重建模型预测相机的姿势,深度和3D点映射来自单个前传的一组图像[6,7,8]. 他们接受了关于大型和多样化图像集的培训,并附有3D注释[6,8],而具有密集的3D地面真伪的事件数据集则要小得多,多样性较小[1,9,5]. 因此,我们从RGB模型中提取几何图案:一个冷冻的RGB老师看到RGB帧,一个事件学生学习复制老师从事件中单独计算出来的与这些帧对应的东西,将老师的前科转移到事件[1,5]. 因为学生继承了这些前科而不是感应器,所以可以继续预测教师框架饱和之处的结构(图1)。

blocks.en: Earlier methods that distil geometry into events used monocular depth models [ 1 , 9 ] or VGGT [ 5 ] as the teacher. Ours is Déjà View [ 8 ] (DVLT), which refines the patch tokens of all images by reusing one shared transformer block K K times, matching much larger feed-forward models with a fraction of their parameters. Because K K is set at inference time, the same model can also trade accuracy for compute [ 8 ] .
blocks.zh: 较早的将几何分解为事件的方法使用单极深度模型[1,9]或VGGT[5]作为老师. Ours is Déjà View [8] (DVLT),它通过重用一个共享的变压器块K K时段来完善所有图像的补丁符号,将更大的feed-forward模型与其一小部分参数相匹配. 由于K K是设定在推论时间的,同一模型也可以交易计算精度[8].

blocks.en: In a well-exposed RGB frame almost every patch carries information, whereas events fire only where brightness changes, mostly at edges and moving texture, leaving textureless areas nearly empty [ 4 , 1 , 9 ] . In DVLT, each step’s update is scaled by a gate that depends only on the step and is thus identical for every patch. We expect this to suit events poorly, as sparse patches may contribute little early in the refinement and benefit from context once nearby dense regions are resolved. We therefore introduce sparsity-aware adaptive gating (SAAG), which fine-tunes this gate for events and adds a small per-patch correction conditioned on event density and the current step.
blocks.zh: 在暴露良好的RGB框架中,几乎每个补丁都携带信息,而事件只有在亮度变化时才开火,大多在边缘和移动的纹理上,使无纹理区域几乎空 [4, 1, 9]. 在DVLT中,每个步骤的更新由一个只取决于该步骤的闸门缩放,因此每个补丁都是一样的. 我们期望这将对事件不利,因为一旦解决了附近的密集地区,稀疏的斑点可能对改进工作起不到什么作用,并从环境中受益。 因此,我们引入了Sparsity-aware adaptable gating(SAAG),它为事件细化了这个门,并增加了一个以事件密度和当前步骤为条件的每行小幅校正.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows. • Déjà-Events, an event-only feed-forward geometry model distilled from DVLT that predicts depth, camera pose and pointmaps in a single forward pass, without depth or pose ground truth while training about 1% of its parameters. • State-of-the-art event-only 3D reconstruction: of the event-based methods we evaluate, Déjà-Events has the lowest pointmap error on EventScape and, zero-shot, on the real MVSEC and DSEC datasets, with about a tenth of EventVGGT’s parameters. • Sparsity-aware adaptive gating, which conditions the gates of the shared block on the event density of each patch, so that the recursion adapts to where events actually fire.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下。 • Déjà-Events,这是从DVLT中提炼出来的一种仅能提供消息的几何模型,在一次前传中预测深度、相机姿势和指针,没有深度或地面真实性,同时训练大约1%的参数。 · 最新事件3D重建:在我们评价的基于事件的方法中,Déjà-Events在EventScape上有最小的点映射误差,在MVSEC和DSEC真正的数据集上则零拍,其中大约占EventVGGT参数的十分之一. ^ Sparsity-aware 适应性标注,将共享块的大门条件为每个补丁的事件密度,使复发适应事件实际发射的地方.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Feed-forward reconstruction models regress cameras and 3D structure directly from images. DUSt3R [ 11 ] and MASt3R [ 12 ] predict pointmaps for pairs of images, and DUSt3R fuses larger sets through a global alignment optimisation, whereas VGGT [ 6 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 13 ] , MapAnything [ 7 ] and Depth Anything 3 [ 14 ] process all views jointly and recover cameras, depth and points in one forward pass through a deep stack of transformer layers. DVLT [ 8 ] instead applies a single shared block for a number of steps chosen at inference.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward重建模型直接从图像中倒退相机和3D结构. DUST3R [11] 和 MAST3R [12] 预测成对图像的点图,DUST3R 引信通过全球对齐优化,而VGGT [6], XXX 3\pi^{3} [13], MapAnything [7] 和深度 Anything 3 [14] 处理所有视图并回收相机,深度和前方的点数通过一叠深的变压器层. DVLT [8] 转而对一些推断选定的步骤适用一个共享块.

blocks.en: Early event-based methods recovered structure geometrically, for example by a space sweep along a known camera trajectory in EMVS [ 15 ] . Learned depth estimators either reconstruct intensity images from events with E2VID [ 16 ] and apply a frame-based depth network to them [ 4 ] , or regress depth directly, as E2Depth [ 4 ] does with a recurrent convolutional network and EReFormer [ 17 ] with a recurrent vision transformer. Their depth maps can be combined with camera poses from event visual odometry such as DEVO [ 18 ] to form pointmaps. Other models predict pointmaps directly by adding events to the feed-forward models above, while keeping RGB as an input: EAG3R [ 19 ] adds events to handle dynamic and low-light scenes, and Interp3R [ 20 ] uses them to interpolate a frame-based model’s pointmaps between frames. A concurrent work, Event3R [ 2 ] instead reconstructs from events alone, training a pairwise backbone initialised from DUSt3R with ground-truth and self-supervised losses, and fusing more than two views by global optimisation. EvGGS [ 21 ] also works from events alone, but needs known camera poses to place the 3D Gaussians it predicts.
blocks.zh: 早期基于事件的方法以几何方式恢复结构,例如沿着EMVS中已知的相机轨迹进行空间扫描[15]. 获得的深度估计器或重建E2VID[16]事件产生的强度图像,并对它们应用一个帧式深度网络[4],或直接递减深度,如E2深度[4]使用反复的转录网络和EReFormer[17]使用反复的视觉变压器. 他们的深度图可以和镜头姿势结合,从事件视觉光度测量学如DEVO [18] 形成点图. 其他模型直接通过向上面的向导模型中添加事件来预测点图,同时保留RGB作为输入: EAG3R [19] 添加事件处理动态和低光场景,Interp3R [20] 利用它们将一个基于帧模型的点图插到帧之间. 一项同时进行的工作,即Event3R[2],而仅从事件中重建,培训DUST3R的双向主干线,并带有地面真实性和自我监督的损失,通过全球优化使两个以上的观点相互融合。 EvGGS [21] 也只靠事件工作,但需要已知的相机姿势来放置它预测的3D高斯人.

blocks.en: Another line of work, motivated partly by the scarcity of event recordings with dense 3D labels, distils RGB foundation models which requires only paired frames and events. Depth AnyEvent [ 1 ] supervises an event student with the depth that a monocular RGB model predicts on aligned frames. EventDAM [ 9 ] also distils a monocular model; it scores the event sparsity of each patch and uses this score to mix RGB and event features into auxiliary depth targets, to weight feature distillation, and to enforce consistency across sparsity levels. EventVGGT [ 5 ] distils VGGT, aligning the features of an event student with the teacher’s alongside a depth loss on randomly mixed RGB and event features and a temporal-consistency loss.
blocks.zh: 另一条工作线,部分是由于缺少带有密集的3D标签的事件录音,提炼了仅需要对框和事件的RGB基础模型. 深度 AnyEvent [1] 监管一个事件学生,其深度为单光学RGB模型在对齐的帧上预测. EventDAM [9] 还可以提炼一个单体模型;它会给每个补丁的事件孢子分数,并利用这个分数将RGB和事件特征混合到辅助深度目标中,进行重力特征蒸馏,并强制实施各个孢子级别的一致性. EventiveVGGT [5] 精选 VGGT, 将事件学生的特征与老师的深度损失相配合,

blocks.en: Event-specific networks exploit sparsity for efficiency by recomputing activations only where new events arrive, as AsyNet [ 22 ] does with sparse convolutions and AEGNN [ 23 ] on an event graph. Adaptive computation methods instead learn how much computation to spend: Adaptive Computation Time [ 24 ] and PonderNet [ 25 ] learn how many recurrent steps to take, Universal Transformers [ 26 ] apply one shared block recurrently under such a halting rule, and Mixture-of-Depths [ 27 ] learns which tokens may skip a layer. Among the distilled models above, only EventDAM [ 9 ] makes event sparsity explicit, and it does so in the training objective; REALM [ 28 ] and EventVGGT [ 5 ] align features without conditioning on it. We instead let sparsity steer the refinement itself, by conditioning the shared block’s gates on the event density of each patch, which adds no loss term and only a few thousand parameters.

blocks.en: III-B Feature distillation
blocks.zh: III-B 特性蒸馏

blocks.en: We distil the teacher into the student on sets of S S consecutive views, each consisting of an RGB frame and the events of its time window. In EventScape, on which we distil, the frame and the event camera share a viewpoint and a pixel grid, so the n n -th token of the student covers the same part of the scene as the n n -th token of the teacher. The student is moreover initialised from the teacher and adapted only by LoRA, so it starts inside the teacher’s token space; the two can therefore be compared directly in latent space (Sec. III-B2 ).

blocks.en: III-B 1 Event tokenisation
blocks.zh: III-B 1 事件标识

blocks.en: For each frame, the events in its time window are accumulated into a voxel grid of five time bins, in which every event adds its polarity, + 1 +1 for brightening and − 1 -1 for darkening, to its pixel, split linearly between the two nearest bins [ 33 ] . Each bin is then divided by its Euclidean norm over the image, which makes the grid invariant to how many events the window happens to contain. The input stem turns this grid into a three-channel image that DINOv2 can read: at each pixel the three channels hold the accumulated positive polarity, the accumulated absolute polarity and the accumulated negative polarity, summed over the bins, and each channel is divided by its maximum over the frame. This image is normalised with a per-channel scale and shift that start at the ImageNet normalisation values and are learned, so that they can adapt to events.
blocks.zh: 对于每个帧,其时间窗口中的事件被累积成一个五时桶的voxel网格,其中每个事件都增加了它的极性,+1+1用于亮度,−1-1用于暗度,在它的像素上,在两个最近的bin之间线性分割[33]. 然后,每个垃圾桶被它的Euclidean规范对图像进行分割,这使得网格对窗口恰好包含的多少事件不具有变化性. 输入干使这个网格变成一个DINov2可以读取的三通道图像:在每一个像素上,三个通道都持有累积的正极性,累积的绝对极性以及累积的负极性,总和在bin上方,每个通道在帧上按其最大分. 这个图像通过每个通道的尺度和移位来正常化,这些移位从ImageNet的正常化值开始,并被学习,以便它们能够适应事件.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Teacher and baselines
blocks.zh: 教师和基线

blocks.en: The teacher is the frozen DVLT model [ 8 ] . It sees RGB frames rather than events, so we report it in italics as a reference and not as a competitor. Our event student, Déjà-Events, is distilled on the EventScape training split without any depth or pose ground truth, for 20,000 steps on clips of 2 to 18 views, with LoRA rank 16 and 1.6 M trained parameters, using AdamW with a cosine schedule from peak learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} (a tenth of that for adapters on pretrained weights) and weight decay 0.05.
blocks.zh: 老师是冷冻的DVLT模型 [8]. 它把RGB框架而不是事件,所以我们用斜体报告它作为参考而不是竞争对手. 我们的活动学生Déjà-Events在EventionScape训练中被分解而没有任何深度或提出地面真相,在2至18个视图的短片上排出2万步,LORA排名16和1.6M训练参数,使用AdamW,其同声表从峰值学习率3×10−4 3\times 10^{-4}(对预训练重量的适配器来说是该表的十分之一)和重量衰减0.05.

blocks.en: We compare against three kinds of event-based methods, which also form the groups of Table III . The depth-only networks are E2Depth [ 4 ] and EReFormer [ 17 ] , retrained on EventScape, and DepthAnyEvent and its recurrent variant DepthAnyEvent-R [ 1 ] , abbreviated DAE and DAE-R, which build on Depth Anything V2 [ 35 ] and whose released checkpoints were trained on EventScape. EventVGGT [ 5 ] predicts depth and pose with two separately trained checkpoints: Option A takes depth from the depth checkpoint and pose and intrinsics from the pose checkpoint, and Option B takes all three from the pose checkpoint, making it a single model. We run both released checkpoints with the authors’ inference code and event representation, unmodified. For visual odometry we use DEVO [ 18 ] , and pairing its poses with each depth network gives modular pipelines, which are lifted to 3D with the ground-truth intrinsics, whereas Déjà-Events, its teacher and EventVGGT use the intrinsics they predict.
blocks.zh: 我们比较三种基于事件的方法,它们也构成表三的分组。 只有深度的网络是E2深度[4]和EReFormer[17],在EventScape上重新训练,以及DepthAnyEvent及其经常变体DepthAnyEvent-R[1],缩写DAE和DAE-R,它们建立在EffectAnything V2[35]上,其释放的检查站在EventScape上训练. EventVGGT [5] 预测深度和设置两个经过单独训练的检查站: 选项 A从深度检查站取深,姿势检查站取内在,选择B从姿势检查站取三,使其成为单一模式. 我们既管理放行的检查站,又使用提交人的推断代码和未经修改的事件说明。 在视觉测量方面,我们使用DEVO [18],将它的姿势与每个深度网络配对,提供了模块化的管道,这些管道与地面真实的内在内容一起升到3D,而Déjà-Events,它的老师和EventVGGT则使用它们预测的内在内容.

blocks.en: IV-B Datasets
blocks.zh: 四-B 数据集

blocks.en: EventScape [ 36 ] is simulated in CARLA [ 37 ] with a 512 × 256 512{\times}256 event camera and dense depth and poses; we distil on Town01 to Town03 and test on the 116 sequences of its released Town05 test set, capping depth at 200 m. MVSEC [ 38 ] records driving with a 346 × 260 346{\times}260 DAVIS346, and we use four of its outdoor drives, one by day and three at night, with the lidar depth capped at 80 m. DSEC [ 39 ] records driving with a 640 × 480 640{\times}480 event camera; since its test split has no public ground truth, we follow [ 40 , 1 ] and use ten validation sequences held out from its training split, with lidar-based depth that DSEC limits to 50 m and pseudo ground-truth poses that we obtain by lidar odometry [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 事件Scape [36]在CARLA [37] 中模拟一个512×256 512{\times}256事件摄像头以及密集深度和姿势;我们在Town01上提取到Town03,测试其发布的Town05测试集的116个序列,在200米处封顶深度. MVSEC [38]记录驾驶时使用346×260{\tims}260 DAVIS346,我们使用其4个室外驱动器,一天和3个室外驱动器,在80米处封顶。 DSEC [39]记录驾驶时使用640×480{\640{\tims}480个事件摄像头;由于其测试分裂没有公开地面真实性,我们遵循[40,1] 并使用从训练分裂中保持的10个验证序列,基于Lidar的深度,DSEC限制在50米和伪地面真实性,我们通过Lidar odometure[41]。

blocks.en: IV-C Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 四-C 评价协议

blocks.en: Each test sequence is cut into non-overlapping 18-frame windows, which every method processes at its own input resolution; EReFormer’s positional embeddings are hardcoded for a 224 × 224 224{\times}224 input, so on DSEC its predictions and the ground truth are centre-cropped to 16% of the frame, and its numbers there are not strictly comparable with the rest. Because DAE and DAE-R predict depth only up to scale and shift, depth is aligned with a median-based scale and shift. Pose and pointmaps are aligned with Sim(3), and ground-truth points are expressed in the window’s first camera. None of the baselines were trained on MVSEC or DSEC.
blocks.zh: 每个测试序列被切成非重叠的18帧窗口,每个方法都按自己的输入分辨率处理; EReFormer的定位嵌入器被硬编码为224×224\224\times}224输入,因此在DSEC上,其预测和地面真相被中央挤压到框架的16%,其数字与其他数字没有严格的可比性. 由于DAE和DAE-R只能预测深度到规模和转移,深度与基于中位的尺度和转移一致. Pose和指针与Sim(3)对齐,地面真实点在窗口的第一镜头中表示. 没有一个基线受过MVSEC或DSEC的培训。

blocks.en: Depth is measured by the absolute relative error (AbsRel) and Δ 1 \Delta_{1} , the fraction of pixels within a factor of 1.25 of ground truth. Pose is measured by the absolute trajectory error (ATE) in meters and AUC 20 , the area under the accuracy curve, up to 20 ∘ , of the larger of each frame pair’s rotation and translation-direction errors [ 42 ] . For pointmaps, we follow DVLT [ 8 ] and report AbsRel, the point error relative to the ground-truth distance, and Inl@25, the fraction of points within 25% relative error, which is the 3D analogue of Δ 1 \Delta_{1} .

blocks.en: On EventScape, Déjà-Events’s trajectory error is a little over half that of DEVO and a small fraction of EventVGGT’s (Table II ). On the real sensors, DEVO has the lowest translation errors, with the student second. EventVGGT’s camera head does not recover the ego-motion on any dataset: its translation directions are close to chance. The teacher remains more accurate than the student on EventScape and DSEC. MVSEC is the exception, where the student’s trajectory error falls below the teacher’s owing to the night drives, in which low illumination degrades the RGB input (Sec. V-D ).

The ordering holds zero-shot on the real sensors. On MVSEC, Déjà-Events leads every event-based method and also reconstructs the scene more accurately than its teacher, although the teacher has the lower depth error, and on DSEC it leads with about half the relative error of Option A. blocks.en: Two effects explain these rankings. First, pose errors matter less than depth errors. A window covers only a short stretch of the drive, so a wrong pose shifts the points by at most the distance travelled, which is small compared with their depth. This is why EventVGGT still reconstructs reasonably well despite its near-static cameras (Table II ): its two options use the same poses and intrinsics, and Option A, which has the better depth, is ahead of Option B on every dataset. Second, the intrinsics matter when their error is large. On MVSEC, the teacher predicts a focal length 2.8 times too long and Déjà-Events one 1.6 times too long, which is why the teacher reconstructs the scene worse than its student despite better depth. Smaller errors cost little: EventVGGT’s focal length is about a quarter too short on every dataset, and that of Déjà-Events is 30% too short on DSEC, where it still leads.

blocks.en: At night, Déjà-Events already has less than half its teacher’s trajectory error and a more accurate reconstruction, while the teacher keeps the lower relative depth error. The distillation on day 1 transfers to night: relative depth error falls below the teacher’s and pose accuracy reaches the teacher’s level, while the trajectory error is unchanged. The reconstruction, however, becomes less accurate than the zero-shot model’s. We attribute this to the camera intrinsics through which the pointmap is formed: the extra epoch pulls the predicted focal length towards the teacher’s, 2.8 times the true value, whereas the zero-shot model overestimates it by only 1.6 times.

blocks.en: VI Discussion
blocks.zh: 六. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Déjà-Events gives the most accurate event-only reconstruction we measure on all three datasets, and it does so from a model an order of magnitude smaller than its closest competitor: 118 M parameters against EventVGGT’s 1.16 B, at less than half its compute and 40% of its memory (Table V ). Only 1.6 M of those parameters are trained, and none of that training uses depth or pose ground truth, because the geometric prior and the decoders are inherited from the RGB teacher and only the encoding of events has to be learned.
blocks.zh: Déjà-Events给出了我们在所有三个数据集上测量的最精确的仅事件重建,它从一个模型中给出了比其最接近的竞争对手小的量级:118 M参数对比EventVGGT的1.16 B,其计算率不到一半,其内存的40%(表五). 这些参数中只有1.6M得到训练,而且这些训练都没有使用深度或形成地面真理,因为前几何和解码器都是从RGB老师那里继承的,只能学习事件的编码.

blocks.en: Outside MVSEC the student stays behind its teacher by a margin related to the quality of the frames the teacher receives rather than to the distillation. It is widest on DSEC, whose colour frames stay well exposed even in its darkest sequences, and smallest on MVSEC, whose low-resolution greyscale frames come from three night drives and one daylight drive; there the student already reconstructs the scene more accurately than its teacher, and distillation on the day sequence brings its night depth error below the teacher’s as well (Table IV ). Because the student is trained to reproduce its teacher, it can overtake it only where the teacher’s input fails, and driving data rarely leaves the regime its frame cameras handle. Future work should therefore evaluate on agile flight, where motion blur degrades the frames, to test whether events overtake them there.
blocks.zh: 在MVSEC之外,学生留在教师后面,与教师得到的帧质量有关,而不是与蒸馏有关。 校对:Soup 只有在老师的输入失败时, 才能超越, 驾驶数据也很少离开政府, 因此,今后的工作应评估飞行的敏捷性,因为移动模糊会降低帧,以检验事件是否超过帧。

blocks.en: How much the predicted camera costs can be measured by projecting the same depth and poses through the ground-truth calibration. On MVSEC this lowers the teacher’s pointmap error by 18% and the student’s by 7%, leaving the two within 0.013 of each other, and it turns the student distilled on day 1 from the least into the most accurate reconstruction we obtain on that sensor, which confirms that its regression is one of intrinsics rather than of depth. On DSEC the same substitution removes about a sixth of the student’s error and leaves the teacher well ahead, so the gap there is depth, not the camera. Intrinsics are nonetheless the cheapest of these errors to remove, because a deployed camera is calibrated: fitting the camera head of an already distilled student to that calibration would repair its weakest output while depth and pose remain label-free.
blocks.zh: 通过地面真实度的校准,对相同的深度进行投影,可以测量出多少预计的相机成本。 在MVSEC上,这把老师的点图误差降低了18 % , 学生的点图误差降低了7 % , 使得两者彼此之间的距离在0.013 以内, 并且将第1天蒸馏出来的学生从最少的地方变成了我们从传感器上得到的最准确的重建, 这证实了它的回归是内在的而不是深度的。 在DSEC上, 同样的替代可以消除学生的六分之一的误差, 让老师领先, 尽管如此,内摄是这些错误中最廉价的去除,因为部署的相机是校准的:将已经蒸馏过的学生的相机头安装在校准中,将修复其最弱的输出,同时深度并保持无标签。

blocks.en: An event camera reports each brightness change as it happens, so events record both structure a blurred frame loses and when, inside the interval, that structure moved. The first is what the student already exploits: blur and saturation degrade the teacher’s input while the event stream keeps its edges, which is why it overtakes its teacher where frames fail. The second it does not use. A frame integrates the interval into one image, so the teacher’s tokens cannot represent when anything happened inside it, and our stem discards the same information by summing over the bins (Sec. III-B1 ), which leaves fast motion smeared across the summed image. Reading the bins would sharpen that and, more usefully, give geometry between frames rather than only at them. Doing so from events alone needs targets that vary within the interval, not a temporal encoder by itself.
blocks.zh: 事件摄像头报告每个亮度随其发生而变化,因此事件记录了两个结构一个模糊的帧丢失,当在间隔内,这个结构移动时. 第一个是学生已经利用的东西:模糊和饱和会降低老师的投入,而事件流则保持其边缘,这就是为什么在框架失败时会超越老师。 其第二无用. 一个框架将间隔融合到一个图像中,因此当其中发生任何事件时,老师的标志不能代表,而我们的树干通过在垃圾桶(Sec. III-B1)上进行交响来丢弃同样的信息,这让快速运动在被概括的图像上涂抹。 读这些纸箱会更清晰,更有用的是,在框之间提供几何,而不是仅仅放在框上。 仅从事件来看,就需要有不同时间间隔内的目标,而不是时间编码器。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Déjà-Events, an event-only feed-forward model that predicts
depth, camera pose and pointmaps in a single pass. It is distilled on paired
RGB and event recordings from a frozen RGB teacher, DVLT, which refines its
tokens by reusing one shared block, so it needs no depth or pose ground truth
and trains about 1% of its parameters. Distilled only in simulation, it has
the lowest pointmap error of the event-based methods we evaluate on
EventScape and, zero-shot, on the real MVSEC and DSEC sensors, and the lowest
depth error on EventScape and DSEC, at about a tenth of the strongest baseline’s
parameters.
